cc_switchMsdkeKeyServer Switches CC instance to other UKO instance as MSDKE key server 1.0.0.0
IBM
5655-EKM UKO V2R1+ ccserver
&variables;
MSDKE_UKO_SERVER_NAME Name of UKO Server for keystore services The name of the UKO Server that this instance is supposed to work together with MSDKE variables
&step_stop_server;
Configure MSDKE Support Configure the new server for Microsoft Double Key Encryption
Substitute server.env MSDKE parameters Configure server.env with the specified MSDKE parameters $!{instance-UKO_ADMIN_SERVER} $!{instance-UKO_APPROVER_SERVER} Submit shell script to execute step 1 true
cd ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/servers/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME} mv ./server.env ./server.env.original if [ $? -gt 0 ]; then echo "ERROR: Original server.env not found, make sure you executed base setup"; exit "8"; fi
sedstring="s#^[ \#]*DB_CURRENT_SCHEMA=.*#DB_CURRENT_SCHEMA=${instance-MSDKE_UKO_SERVER_NAME}DB#g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*MSDKE_RABBIT_VIRTUAL_HOST=.*#MSDKE_RABBIT_VIRTUAL_HOST=${instance-MSDKE_UKO_SERVER_NAME}#g;"
sed -e "$sedstring" ./server.env.original > ./server.env
#if(${instance-SERVER_STC_GROUP} != "" && ${instance-SERVER_STC_GROUP}) echo "Transfer ownership of new server.env to ${instance-SERVER_STC_USER} : ${instance-SERVER_STC_GROUP}" chown ${instance-SERVER_STC_USER}:${instance-SERVER_STC_GROUP} ./server.env echo "Change access of new server.env to 750" chmod 640 ./server.env #else echo "Transfer ownership of new server.env to ${instance-SERVER_STC_USER}" chown ${instance-SERVER_STC_USER} ./server.env echo "Change access of new server.env to 700" chmod 600 ./server.env #end
rm ./server.env.original
shell-JCL 2048
